simple.meaning: כַּרְכֹּם (karkôm) is a Hebrew action word meaning “the crocus.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 1 time in Song of Solomon, beginning at Song of Songs 4:14. Its meaning becomes clearer as the uses are compared.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to כַּרְכֹּם (H3750) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.

definitions.full: H3750. karkom כַּרְכֹּם noun [masculine] saffron ( crocus sativus ) (Late Hebrew id. ; and verb denominative כִּרְכֵּם ; Hithpa`el grow yellow, pale ; Aramaic כּוּרְכְּמָא , Arabic = κρόκος , crocus ; Lag Ges. Abh. 58, No. 147 ; so also JHMordt sab Denkm. 83 f. ; otherwise DHM ib. , who compare Sabean כמכם , Arabic = Greek κάγκαμον ); — Song 4:14 ; on meaning see especially Löw No. 162 .
